When those gates trigger, the user does not get a normal refusal; the request is handed to Opus 4.8, which means Anthropic is using model fallback as a control system. tweets.text: We've also added refusal-fallback middleware to the Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, and C# SDKs for client-side retries. Middleware is useful for Claude API providers without support for server-side fallbacks. It detects the refusal, retries on Claude Opus 4.8, and keeps using it for later turns.

tweets.creator: @ClaudeDevs
tweets.text: When a classifier declines, the API re-runs the request on your fallback model in the same round trip. Rate limits and server errors are returned from the API as usual.

tweets.text: With multi-agent orchestration in Claude Managed Agents, you can use Fable to delegate work to dedicated agents using smaller models.

tweets.creator: @ClaudeDevs
tweets.text: Feedback loops work the same as with previous models: give Fable the success criteria to check its results against. This can be /goal in Claude Code or Outcomes in Claude Managed Agents.

tweets.creator: @ClaudeDevs
tweets.text: Prompting gets simpler. Existing prompts or skills developed for prior models are often too prescriptive for Fable. We recommend reviewing and potentially updating or removing older instructions or skills if you find default performance to be better.

tweets.creator: @ClaudeDevs
tweets.text: You may notice that Fable feels different. Thinking is always on, and responses can take longer. Effort controls how much it thinks. We recommend high as the default. In our evals, even low/medium often beat previous models at xhigh, so save xhigh for your hardest problems.

tweets.creator: @ClaudeDevs
tweets.text: Start at the top of your difficulty range: something harder than you'd assume previous versions of Claude can accomplish. Pick a backlog item you'd scope at a week, let Fable 5 interview you for the spec, turn on auto mode, and check back in the morning.

tweets.creator: @ClaudeDevs
tweets.text: In the API, switch the model ID parameter to "claude-fable-5" in both the Messages API and Claude Managed Agents. For some accounts, an admin may need to enable access first. The /claude-api skill in Claude Code can help you build with Fable on the API.

tweets.creator: @ClaudeDevs

Some of these are issues to defend against; some are areas to advance. Mythos has made me & our team feel like we've seen the earliest glimpse of the world we've been talking about.
